value.summary: The change adds .tinysweeper.toml config for embeddings, fixes the Docker compose env vars for GitHub App auth (previously the wrong names were used), mounts .tinysweeper.toml into the container, and adds a MongoDB kernel-bypass shim alongside a new src/findings/summarise.rs module with word-boundary truncation and first-sentence extraction. The code compiles, the shim has a loud-fail guard, and the summarise module includes tests that verify the behaviour and the multibyte panic fix. The removed compose vars (`TINYSWEEPER_GITHUB_*`) were never read by the binary, so this is a fix and not a regression. No test needed for the config or compose changes — they are infrastructure wiring, not behavioural logic. merge after CI.
